info.name: Sonatype Role Memberships API
info.description: Operations tagged Role Memberships across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: sonatype-lifecycle-openapi.yml, sonatype-iq-openapi.yml. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

item.name: Set bulk role members global or repository container

variable.description: (Required) Enter the ownerType.

(Required) Enter the roleId for the role whose members should be set.

Use the Roles REST API for roleIds and descriptions.

request.description:
Use this method to set all members for a specific role in the global or repository container context. This operation atomically replaces all existing members for the role with the provided list.

Permissions required: Edit system configuration and users for a global context or edit access control for a non-global context

response.name: The role membership has been successfully updated with the provided members.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Revoke role membership global or repository container

variable.description: (Required) Enter the value for ownerType. Using `global` will revoke the administrator role.
(Required) Enter the roleId for the role to be revoked.
(Required) Enter the value for memberType, to specify a user or a user group.
(Required) Enter the value for memberName. This can be a username or group name depending upon the value of memberType above.

request.description:
Use this method to revoke roles globally or on all repositories.

Permissions required: Edit system configuration and users for a global context or view IQ elements for a non-global context

response.name: The specified role has been revoked from the user or user group.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Grant role membership global or repository container

variable.description: (Required) Enter the value for the ownerType for which you want to grant the role.

(Required) Enter the roleId for the role to be granted.

Use the Roles REST API for roleIds and descriptions.
(Required) Enter the value for memberType, to specify a user or a user group.
(Required) Enter the value for memberName. This can be a username or group name depending upon the value of memberType above.

request.description:
Use this method to grant a role to a user or user group globally or on all repositories.

Permissions required: Edit system configuration and users for a global context or edit access control for a non-global context

response.name: The specified role has been granted to the users or user groups on the given context.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Get bulk role memberships global or repository container

variable.description: (Required) Enter the value for ownerType.

request.description:
Use this method to retrieve all role memberships for global or repository container context with full details including role names, descriptions, and member information.

Permissions required: Edit system configuration and users for a global context or view IQ elements for a non-global context

response.name: The response contains all roles with their members. Also includes a flag indicating whether group search is enabled.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Set bulk role members non global

variable.description: (Required) Enter the ownerType for which you want to set role members.
(Required) Enter the id associated with the ownerType specified above. For applications, use the public ID. For organizations, repositories, and repository managers, use the internal ID.

(Required) Enter the roleId for the role whose members should be set.

Use the Roles REST API for roleIds and descriptions.

request.description:
Use this method to set all members for a specific role. This operation atomically replaces all existing members for the role with the provided list.

Permissions required: Edit access control

response.name: The role membership has been successfully updated with the provided members.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Revoke role membership application or organization

variable.description: (Required) Enter the value for the ownerType for which you want to revoke the role. Using `global` will revoke the administrator role.
(Required) Enter the internalId associated with the ownerType specified above.
(Required) Enter the roleId for the role to be revoked.
(Required) Enter the value for memberType, to specify a user or a user group.
(Required) Enter the value for memberName. This can be a username or group name depending upon the value of memberType above.

request.description:
Use this method to revoke a role from a user or user group, on a specific application or organization.

Permissions required: Edit access control

response.name: The specified role has been revoked from the user or user group

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Grant role membership application or organization

query.description:
If true, attempts to validate if the specified user or group exists before assigning the role.
If false or omitted, the request behaves as before (no validation check).

variable.description: (Required) Enter the value for the ownerType for which you want to grant the role.
(Required) Enter the value for the internalId associated with the ownerType specified above.

(Required) Enter the roleId for the role to be granted.

Use the Roles REST API for roleIds and descriptions.
(Required) Enter the value for memberType, to specify a user or a user group.
(Required) Enter the value for memberName. This can be a username or group name depending upon the value of memberType above.

request.description:
Use this method to grant a role to a user or user group for the specified application or organization.

Permissions required: Edit access control

response.name: The specified roleId has been has been granted to the user or user group for the requested context.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

query.description:
If true, attempts to validate if the specified user or group exists before assigning the role.
If false or omitted, the request behaves as before (no validation check).

item.name: Get bulk role memberships non global

variable.description: (Required) Enter the ownerType for which you want to retrieve role memberships.
(Required) Enter the corresponding id for the ownerType specified above. For applications, use the public ID. For organizations, repositories, and repository managers, use the internal ID.

request.description:
Use this method to retrieve all role memberships with full details including role names, descriptions, and member information organized by owner (for inheritance display).

Permissions required: Edit system configuration and users for a global context or view IQ elements for a non-global context

response.name:
The response contains all roles with their members organized by owner, including inherited members from parent organizations or repository hierarchies. Also includes a flag indicating whether group search is
enabled.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Get role memberships application or organization

variable.description: (Required) Enter the ownerType for which you want to retrieve users and their role Ids.
(Required) Enter the corresponding id for the ownerType specified above.

request.description:
Use this method to retrieve the users, user groups and the corresponding role Ids.

Permissions required: Edit system configuration and users for a global context or view IQ elements for a non-global context

response.name: The response contains the assigned role Ids, users and user groups for the application or organization requested. It also includes members who inherit a role based on the organization hierarchy.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Get role memberships global or repository container

variable.description: (Required) Enter the value for ownerType. Using `global` will return the users and groups who have been assigned the administrator role.

request.description:
Use this method to retrieve all users and roles globally or for all repositories.

Permissions required: Edit system configuration and users for a global context or view IQ elements for a non-global context

response.name: The response contains all role Ids and the corresponding users/user groups assigned to them, for the ownerType specified. It also includes members who inherit a role based on the organization hierarchy.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic
